title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Contract Data: Guarantee Period End, Annuitization and Maturity
content:
Contract data of each Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities tier for the end of a guarantee period, for annuitization and for maturity.

| Tier | Renewal window after a guarantee period ends | Guarantee period renewed into when no election is made | First contract year in which annuitization is free of surrender charge | Shortest period certain for annuitization free of surrender charge (no life contingency) | Smallest contract value that may be annuitized | Annuitant's maturity age |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 0 days (no renewal window) | 1 year | 2 | 5 years | $5000 | 95 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | 30 calendar days | 3 years | 2 | 5 years | $5000 | 95 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | 30 calendar days | 5 years | 2 | 5 years | $5000 | 95 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | 30 calendar days | 6 years | 2 | 5 years | $5000 | 95 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 30 calendar days | 7 years | 2 | 5 years | $5000 | 95 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 30 calendar days | 10 years | 2 | 5 years | $5000 | 95 |

**Column notes.**

- *Renewal window* — the period after a guarantee period ends during which the owner may withdraw or surrender without surrender charge or elect a different period. The Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity has none.
- *Guarantee period renewed into* — the period the contract renews into when the owner makes no election; on each SecureRate tier it equals the tier's own period length.
- *Smallest contract value that may be annuitized* — a smaller value is paid in a lump sum.
- *Maturity age* — the annuitant's age at which the contract must be annuitized or paid out.

*Example (hypothetical):* an Ashgrove SecureRate 6 whose guarantee period ends without an election renews into a new 6-year period; an Ashgrove SecureRate 10 renews into a new 10-year period.
